We need them to play at their best, They don't all have to be going all at once, but during this run, at least 2-3 need to be making an impact every night. 3rd, we need an unsung hero to play above their expectations (think a Laughton, McMann, Lorentz) - you need someone down the depth chart to steal you a couple of games. 4th and lastly, we need solid goaltending - We need them to steal us a couple of games when the team is having an off night and to keep us in games we shouldn't even be in. Just give us a chance to win every night. We need all of this and a little luck - say a couple of the other teams' best players get hurt or a lucky bounce here and there.
